guides.title: Clipboard Source · setup
guides.before_you_start: Keep your existing values for a read-only tour. Opening this guide does not activate a provider, start services or apply settings.

steps.title: Read clipboard delivery choices
steps.body: Find the clipboard delivery controls and distinguish manual attachment from repeated background use. Check the current selection before copying a harmless image. Clipboard content can change between turns, so verify the image you intend to use. Reading this page does not capture or send it.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Copy an image before attaching
steps.body: Copy an image to the system clipboard from another application, then use the setup controls here to have it attached to a chat turn. Clipboard content is transient; recopy before a turn if you need to rely on it. Observe the next chat turn to see whether the attached image arrived as expected.

steps.title: Describe how the image is interpreted
steps.body: The prompts tab holds wording that shapes how attached images are described or used in chat. Read the existing prompt before editing. Text you save here changes what the model receives with an image, so check one turn after a change to see whether the description matches your intent.

steps.title: Read advanced options first
steps.body: The advanced tab holds less common Clipboard Source settings. Inspect the options in place rather than assuming names. Change one at a time and test with a fresh copied image, since clipboard behavior depends on what was copied immediately before the turn.
